review_candidates.title: Customer Service Engineer (VA ESOM)
review_candidates.description: Overview Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities. By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones. Kentro is hiring an experienced Customer Service Engineer to support our VA-ESOM- End Point Support and Operations Monitoring contract across the United States. The VA is responsible for providing comprehensive onsite and remote support to IT customers across all VA Administrations and special program offices, including direct support of over 340,000 VA employees and thousands of contractors who use government-furnished IT equipment and infrastructure. The VA provides support staff across 100+ CONUS and OCONUS locations, including difficult-to-accommodate locales, such as high cost of living or under-supported economic areas, where VA offices or facilities may be located and require onsite services. A Customer Service Engineer can quickly respond to end-user requests for assistance when existing manuals and scripted responses are insufficient to meet user needs. Must be able to interact with customers, diagnose problems, and lead customers through the necessary steps to correct their issues. Must have experience conducting routine system administration tasks and logging data in system admin logs. Location: Onsite - VACO Area West B (Washington, DC) Shift: Monday - Friday, 6:00am - 2:30pm EST Compensation Range: The anticipated base compensation range for this position is $28.00 – $32.00 hourly and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements. This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability. Responsibilities Support the Government with the installation, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting of computer systems and equipment, ensuring optimal operation and user satisfaction. Assist in delivering both remote and desk-side technical support, responding to IT support tickets, and performing diagnostic and repair activities on both hardware and software components. Aid in setting up and maintaining user accounts, interfacing with other software applications, compiling reports, and responding to customer requests. Assist in the maintenance of Active Directory and other system accounts, support connectivity and client applications, and assist in the configuration and support of local and wide area network services. Monitor open tickets in VA’s ServiceNow customer incident ticketing system to ensure adherence to business processes, and any discrepancies identified shall be reported with proposed corrective actions for approval before implementation. The work environment involves both sedentary and active elements, requiring careful handling of electronic components and adherence to safety precautions to prevent injuries or equipment damage. Utilize debugging protocols and processes. Troubleshoot problems and issues identified by customers and implement corrective actions quickly. Facilitate equipment returns, deployments, unboxing, inventorying, and verification. Possessing the physical capability to handle demanding tasks such as lifting equipment up to 50 pounds and bending, twisting, squatting, reaching, climbing, and crawling to navigate through facility spaces to access and repair equipment. Stand and move throughout the work area for prolonged periods. Communication & Interpersonal Skills Active listening: Understand customer needs and concerns fully before responding. Clear verbal and written communication: Explain technical issues in simple, customer-friendly language. Empathy: Show understanding and patience with frustrated or non-technical customers. Relationship building: Develop trust and rapport with customers and colleagues. Professional demeanor: Represent the company with courtesy and confidence in all interactions. Customer-Centric Mindset Proactive attitude: Anticipate customer needs before they escalate into issues. Continuous improvement: Seek feedback to improve both personal performance and customer experience. Ownership: Take responsibility for resolving issues from start to finish. Travel: A Customer Service Engineer may be asked to provide additional support during temporary periods of increased workload, referred to as “surge capacity.” These requests would be discussed and coordinated beforehand and depending on the event, events may require the need to travel for 2 weeks at a time, equating to 12 consecutive days, departing on Monday, and returning on the Friday of the following week. Overtime is not authorized for any work to include this surge capacity. For work related travel, Kentro will pre-pay specific expenses (airfare, and hotel); expenses that are out-of-pocket will require submission of an expense report in accordance with Kentro policy. Expense reimbursements are paid out weekly. Per diem for meals and lodging will be provided for overnight stays based on the GSA Per Diem Rates for that location. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science, electronics engineering, or other engineering or technical discipline or 8 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education. 2+ years of experience in IT Technical Support, Help Desk or System Administration. Candidates must be able to meet the physical requirements of the role as listed in the job description. Preferred: Experience in conducting routine system administration tasks and logging data in system admin logs Knowledge on a number of debugging protocols and processes Adept knowledge in IT principles and practices, proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, and a basic understanding of system administration in a Windows environment Clearance Requirement: US Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card) Willing and able to get a Public Trust Suitability clearance Must meet updated ID requirements: https://www.gsa.gov/technology/it-contract-vehicles-and-purchasing-programs/federal-credentialing-services/get-appointment-help/bring-required-documents If you do not currently meet the ID requirements outlined, you must be willing and able to update your current forms of ID in a timely manner to complete the suitability process successfully. Health Requirements: This Kentro position provides on-site support for the Department of Veterans Affairs. The Department of Veterans Affairs has facility-specific vaccination and testing requirements (please see the bulleted examples below). If chosen for this role, candidates may be required to show proof that their vaccinations and testing are current. The Kentro Suitability team will provide guidance on what the facility-specific health requirements for this position are, any documents needed, and how to request reasonable accommodation. Yearly Flu Vaccination Tuberculosis testing with a negative result Vaccination records or titer testing required for Measles Mumps and Rubella (MMR), Hepatitis B, and/or Varicella Benefits The Company We believe in generating success collaboratively, enabling long-term mission success, and building trust for the next challenge. With you as our partner, let’s solve challenges, think innovatively, and maximize impact. As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions. We are a close community of experts that pride ourselves on creating an environment defined by teamwork, dedication, and excellence. We hold three ISO certifications (27001:2013, 20000-1:2011, 9001:2015), two CMMI ML 3 ratings (DEV and SVC) and CMMC Level 2 Certification. Industry Recognition Growth | Inc 5000’s Fastest Growing Private Companies, DC Metro List Fastest Growing; Washington Business Journal: Fastest Growing Companies, Top Performing Small Technology Companies in Greater D.C. Culture | Northern Virginia Technology Council Tech 100 Honoree; Virginia Best Place to Work; Washington Business Journal: Best Places to Work, Corporate Diversity Index Winner – Mid-Size Companies, Companies Owned by People of Color; Department of Labor’s HireVets for our work helping veterans transition; SECAF Award of Excellence finalist; Victory Military Friendly Brand; Virginia Values Veterans (V3); Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Corporate Breath Award Benefits We offer competitive benefits package including paid time off, healthcare benefits, supplemental benefits, 401k including an employer match, discount perks, rewards, and more. We invest in our employees – Every employee is eligible for education reimbursement for certifications, degrees, or professional development. We want you to grow as an expert and a leader and offer flexibility for you to take a course, complete a certification, or other professional growth and networking. We are committed to supporting your curiosity and sustaining a culture that prioritizes commitment to continuous professional development. We work hard; we play hard. Kentro is committed to incorporating fun into every day. We dedicate funds for activities – virtual and in-person – e.g., we host happy hours, holiday events, fitness & wellness events, and annual celebrations. In alignment with our commitment to our communities, we also host and attend charity galas/events. We believe in appreciating your commitment and building a positive workspace for you to be creative, innovative, and happy. review_candidates.title: Vil du jobbe med Azure Storage og bygge fremtidens skyløsninger?
review_candidates.description: Skatteetaten har en skystrategi som setter retning for vår overgang til økt bruk av skybaserte IT-tjenester. For å lykkes med dette trenger vi å styrke laget som jobber med Azure Storage Services og tilhørende teknologier. Vi ser derfor etter deg som ønsker å være med på å utvikle og videreutvikle fundamentet for våre skyløsninger. Vi ser etter deg som har relevant IT-utdanning, og som gjennom studier, prosjektarbeid eller praksis har fått praktisk erfaring med skyteknologi. Det er spesielt relevant hvis du har praktisk erfaring med Azure, lagringstjenester, automatisering og/eller infrastruktur som kode (IaC). For alt hva vi vet kanskje du har vært IKT-lærling. Du er nysgjerrig, liker å sette deg inn i tekniske problemstillinger og motiveres av å lære og utvikle deg. Vi forventer ikke at du kan alt fra før, men ønsker at du har et godt teknisk fundament og interesse for fagområdet. Som Cloud Engineer vil du være med på å utvikle, automatisere og videreutvikle Azure-plattformen vår. Du vil jobbe med Infrastructure as Code, primært Bicep og Terraform, og bidra til gode prinsipper for struktur, Governance, sikkerhet og automatisering. En viktig del av rollen vil også være å utvikle og forbedre CI/CD-pipelines og automatiserte leveranseløp. GitHub vil være et sentralt verktøy, blant annet gjennom GitHub Actions og gode arbeidsprosesser for kode, automatisering og deployment. Hvorfor bør du søke? Hos oss får du muligheten til å jobbe med spennende arbeidsoppgaver og utvikle deg i et støttende og inkluderende miljø. Vi verdsetter initiativ og egendriv, og vi tror på å ha det gøy på jobb. Det er viktig for oss at du trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team for å oppnå felles prioriteringer og målsettinger. Hvis du liker Azure, automatisering og Infrastructure as Code, og mener at en god plattform skal gjøre det enkelt å gjøre ting riktig, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg. Hvordan jobber vi? I teamet jobber vi i fellesskap og bistår med hverandres arbeidsoppgaver, vi tror på styrken i samarbeid og at vi er best sammen. Allikevel vil en god del av hverdagen går med til å forvalte og videreutvikle ditt eget arbeidsområde. Du vil få stor frihet i hvordan du legger opp arbeidsdagen og gjennomføre egne arbeidsoppgaver Hva går jobben ut på? Azure Storage Services og andre relevante tjenester i Azure etablering, konfigurasjon og forvaltning av lagringsløsninger automatisering og infrastruktur som kode (IaC) scripting og tekniske verktøy forenkle, automatisere og optimalisere administreringen og styringen av skyressurser ift. lagring, backup og restore bistå prosjekter med mulighetsrom innenfor lagring og gjenoppretting i offentlig sky overvåking, feilsøking og forbedring av løsningene sikkerhet, tilgangsstyring og god forvaltning av data samarbeid med andre tekniske fagmiljøer Du vil få jobbe sammen med erfarne kolleger og gradvis bygge kompetanse og ta tørre ansvar Hvilken kompetanse er viktig i denne rollen? relevant fagskole/høyskole-/universitetsutdanning innen IKT. Særlig relevant erfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet. det er en fordel om du gjennom studier, prosjektoppgaver, praksis eller egen interesse har fått praktisk erfaring med skytjenester, og da primært Microsoft Azure kjennskap til skylagring og interesse for å arbeide med Azure Storage Services, eksempelvis Blob Storage, Files og andre lagringstjenester kjennskap til scripting, automatisering eller infrastruktur som kode, for eksempel PowerShell, Terraform eller tilsvarende. Git/GitHub actions eller tilsvarende CI/CD ha et bevisst forhold til IT-sikkerhet god skriftlig og muntlig formidlingsevne på norsk Det er en fordel med kompetanse innenfor flere av disse områdene (ikke et MÅ-krav): Azure backup og recovery løsninger for databaser, storage accounts samt Azure Business Continuity Center lagringsløsninger forståelse for kontainerteknologi Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du: er nysgjerrig og liker å lære nye ting tør å stille spørsmål og utfordre etablerte løsninger liker å sette deg inn i tekniske problemstillinger arbeider strukturert og analytisk liker å automatisere fremfor å gjøre den samme oppgaven manuelt flere ganger deler kunnskap og spiller andre gode ønsker å utvikle deg faglig over tid Hvorfor skal du velge oss? Hos oss får du muligheten til å bygge kompetanse på Azure og moderne skyløsninger i et stort teknologimiljø. Du vil få erfarne kolleger rundt deg og muligheten til å lære gjennom praktiske oppgaver. Samtidig får du være med på å påvirke hvordan løsningene våre skal utvikles videre. Vi forventer ikke at du kan alt fra første dag. Vi ser etter potensial, teknologiforståelse og lysten til å lære. Stillingen lønnes som rådgiver/overingeniør eller seniorrådgiver/senioringeniør fra kr. 600 000 – 750 000. For spesielt kvalifiserte kan høyere lønn vurderes. Stillingen har seks måneders prøvetid, og når vi jobber på tvers av flere lokasjoner kan det noen ganger være nødvendig å reise litt.Vi gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater. Gjennom bakgrunnssjekken verifiserer vi utdanning og arbeidserfaring, samt ID-sjekk. I tillegg kan det bli gjennomført søk i åpne kilder, søk på næringsinteresser, samt et mulig sikkerhetsintervju. Verdt å merke seg før du søker Vi er mer opptatt av hva du kan, dine erfaringer og kompetanse enn hvor flink du er til å skrive en jobbsøknad. Derfor ber vi deg om å levere en god og beskrivende CV hvor du får frem hva du har gjort og oppnådd som gjør deg kvalifisert for stillingen du søker på. Du trenger altså ikke å skrive eller legge ved et søknadsbrev. Vi vil at du skal føle deg trygg på valget når du takker ja til å jobbe hos oss. Dersom du er aktuell for stillingen, tilbyr vi deg en omvendt referansesjekk . Det betyr at du får ringe noen av våre medarbeidere og stille de spørsmålene du måtte ønske for å finne bedre ut om vi er en god match. Vi er på jobb for alle og skal være et godt sted å jobbe for alle. Likeverd, likestilling og mangfold er en del av kulturen vår og vi har nulltoleranse for diskriminerende praksis og oppførsel. Har du hull i CV-en din, funksjonsnedsettelse eller innvandrerbakgrunn vil vi oppfordre deg til å krysse av for dette når du søker stillingen hos oss. Det gir deg mulighet for å få positiv særbehandling. Vi kaller alltid inn minst én kvalifisert kandidat fra hver av disse gruppene til intervju. Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Det er mulig å be om å bli unntatt denne søkerlisten. Da må du i så fall begrunne hvorfor du ønsker det, og vi tar deretter stilling til om vi kan innvilge ønsket ditt. Kan vi ikke det, hører du selvsagt fra oss. De største samfunnsutfordringene krever forskjellige hoder, forskjellige måter å tenke på og at forskjellige fagområder jobber sammen. Når flinke folk fra ulike fagområder jobber sammen, finner vi smartere løsninger som sikrer et velfungerende skattesystem. Vi består av et direktorat, fem divisjoner som har landsdekkende ansvar, og viktigst av alt: litt over 7 000 medarbeidere fra forskjellige fagområder med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring, måter å tenke på og perspektiver. Vil du bli enda bedre kjent med oss kan du lese mer på skatteetaten.no

Valoramos especialmente la disposición para aprender, la iniciativa y el compromiso, por sobre una amplia experiencia laboral. Buscamos a alguien que quiera desarrollarse, asumir nuevos desafíos y aportar activamente al equipo. review_candidates.title: Chief Operating and Network Officer - National Black Child Development Institute
review_candidates.description: Organization Overview: NATIONAL BLACK CHILD DEVELOPMENT INSTITUTE For more than 50 years, the National Black Child Development Institute (NBCDI) has been a powerful voice for Black children and families, championing their strengths, potential, and right to thrive. Founded in 1970, NBCDI is a national nonprofit that advances research and community engagement to improve the conditions in which Black children grow and thrive. NBCDI is evolving into a national “think and do tank,” moving from a collection of individual programs toward an integrated strategy to shape a bold national agenda for Black children from birth through age eight. This evolution aims to drive meaningful change in the policies, systems, investments, and public narratives that shape opportunities for Black children and families. Central to this vision is NBCDI's National Village Network, a network of locally based affiliates connecting community leaders, families, educators, and advocates. The National Office provides research, policy leadership, resources, infrastructure, and national relationships to influence change at scale. The Village Network brings trusted community relationships, local knowledge, leadership, and grassroots advocacy that inform national priorities and mobilize action within communities. Together, they connect community experience with national influence, ensuring NBCDI's work is grounded in the lives of Black children and families. Today, NBCDI is entering an important next chapter. The organization has doubled its operating budget over the past five years and is evolving toward a more centralized, outcomes-driven national model that more intentionally connects its research, policy, advocacy, and network. With an approximately $3 million operating budget, a lean national team, and funding driven largely by private philanthropy, NBCDI is focused on building the infrastructure and financial sustainability needed to extend its influence and impact for years to come. Position Summary: Chief Operating & Network Officer The National Black Child Development Institute (NBCDI) seeks a highly capable Chief Operating & Network Officer to serve as the organization’s senior internal operator and a close partner to the President & CEO. As part of a nine-person national team, this leader will serve as the integrator across the organization, translating NBCDI’s vision and priorities into coordinated execution across operations, finance, people, programs, network engagement, and revenue. This is a critical institution-building role for a results-oriented executive who can bring structure, discipline, and accountability while building the operating infrastructure and organizational capacity needed to realize NBCDI’s ambitious vision for the future. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone equally comfortable building systems and rolling up their sleeves to make them work. This inaugural role will strengthen NBCDI’s internal infrastructure, ensuring essential processes, workflows, and SOPs are clearly documented, accessible, understood, and consistently followed. They will also serve as the primary leader for NBCDI’s key consultant and vendor relationships, including outsourced accounting, technology, HR, and legal partners, ensuring these critical functions are well coordinated and effectively support the organization. The role will also oversee the operating infrastructure and standards supporting the national Village Network. Reporting to the President & CEO and supervising two direct reports, this leader will help build an operating environment where information is easy to find, responsibilities are clear, functional leaders are empowered to own their work , teams and partners work effectively together, and the CEO can remain focused on NBCDI’s vision, external leadership, and national influence. Key Responsibilities INTERNAL OPERATIONS & PEOPLE LEADERSHIP Oversee NBCDI's internal operations, including finance, HR, technology, operations, legal, compliance, and risk management. Provide hands-on financial oversight of budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, financial reporting, internal controls, and audit readiness, working closely with outsourced accounting firm. Supervise and develop direct reports while strengthening management practices, performance expectations, and accountability across the organization. Establish clear functional ownership and decision-making authority, enabling leaders to manage their respective areas effectively while maintaining NBCDI's collaborative, supportive culture. OPERATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE & ORGANIZATIONAL SYSTEMS Build and strengthen NBCDI's internal operating infrastructure, identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve how work moves across the organization. Optimize existing technology platforms and evaluate new solutions to improve planning, project tracking, workflows, and organizational efficiency. Create a centralized, accessible digital system for organizational policies, procedures, contracts, records, templates, and other foundational documents. Assess future staffing and capacity needs to ensure NBCDI has the people and resources needed to support its long-term growth. NETWORK & CENTRALIZED OPERATIONS DESIGN Assess NBCDI’s current network model and clarify the value proposition, expectations, and relationship between the national office, affiliates, partners, and communities. Conduct an audit of existing affiliates, agreements, and compliance requirements and address outstanding documentation or accountability issues. Formalize the affiliate lifecycle, including inquiry, vetting, approval, onboarding, participation, renewal, compliance, and offboarding, with clear tools and resources at each stage. Partner with the Network Engagement function to establish the infrastructure, standards, and feedback mechanisms that support Village relationships, shared learning, engagement, and community activation BOARD & EXTERNAL PARTNER COMMUNICATION Ensure the President & CEO has timely visibility into financial performance, operational risks, organizational priorities, and decisions requiring executive attention. Coordinate accurate and timely Board and committee materials and ensure commitments and action items receive appropriate follow-through. Manage NBCDI’s outsourced accounting, technology, HR, and legal providers, including reviewing contracts, scopes, service quality, performance, and overall value to the organization. Serve as the internal point of coordination between external providers and NBCDI staff, ensuring issues are resolved efficiently and outsourced functions remain responsive to organizational needs. REVENUE & FUNDRAISING SUPPORT Partner with Development and Finance to establish reliable systems for revenue tracking, forecasting, grant management, and reporting. Ensure clear coordination and accountability across Development, Finance, programs, research, advocacy, and network initiatives to support funded commitments and organizational priorities. Monitor revenue performance, funding risks, grant deliverables, and reporting timelines, ensuring timely visibility and follow-through across responsible teams. Strengthen the internal processes and information flow that enable Development leadership to execute fundraising strategies, manage institutional partnerships, and steward funder relationships effectively. Leadership Competencies OPERATIONAL & INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDER NBCDI seeks a builder and operator, not primarily a strategist or thought leader. This leader will have a demonstrated track record of strengthening or redesigning organizations during periods of growth, stabilization, or transition. They know how to take a vision and turn it into practical infrastructure - systems, plans, processes, timelines, ownership, and measurable results - and are comfortable building what does not yet exist. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL BUSINESS ACUMEN The ideal candidate will be a strong organizational generalist with enough depth across finance, HR, operations, technology, administration, and nonprofit management to understand how the pieces fit together. They will bring particular strength in financial management, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, nonprofit financial reporting, and grant management, and know how to ask the right questions, recognize risk, and effectively manage both internal resources and outside experts. PEOPLE & CHANGE LEADERSHIP This leader will have experience guiding teams through ambiguity and organizational change with steadiness and sound judgment. They will bring clarity to roles and expectations, strengthen management practices, and help people successfully adopt new ways of working. Their approach will be collaborative and low-ego - able to provide context, build buy-in, and hold people accountable without creating unnecessary bureaucracy or disrupting NBCDI’s culture of care. NETWORK & ECOSYSTEM LEADERSHIP The successful candidate will understand how to lead within a distributed or networked organization, with experience managing affiliate networks, coalitions, partner ecosystems, multi-site organizations, or similar models. They will know how to create greater consistency and accountability across a national network while preserving the relationships, local leadership, community voice, and field learning that give the network its value. Priorities for the First Year FIRST 90 DAYS Review the existing strategic priorities and internal organizational design work, and bring expertise and fresh perspective to prioritize and begin implementation Stabilize monthly financial reporting, cash-flow visibility, and internal operating rhythms. Align the leadership team around clear priorities, roles, decision rights, and accountability structures. Review the current national office/network operating model and accountability plan, and apply your own expertise and judgment to validate recommendations, identify gaps, and refine priorities for implementation. Build revenue tracking and execution infrastructure in partnership with Development and Finance. Identify issues requiring immediate CEO or Board decisions and establish a clear path for resolution. FIRST 6 - 12 MONTHS Lead day-to-day operations to enable the CEO to focus on institutional direction, national leadership, Board stewardship, and major external relationships. Implement organization-wide project management and accountability systems to track key priorities, Board and funder commitments, timelines, ownership, and follow-through. Implement consistent financial and management rhythms, including timely reporting, forecasting, budget oversight, and proactive identification of organizational risks. Improve coordination across Finance, Operations, Development, programs, HR, research, advocacy, communications, and network-facing work. Formalize the National Office and Village Network operating model, with clear roles, standards, affiliate agreements, compliance processes, and support systems that enable effective network engagement. Location, Compensation and Benefits This is a remote position, with a strong preference for candidates based in Atlanta or the DMV area (Washington, D.C./Maryland/Virginia). NBCDI maintains an office in Silver Spring, Maryland, which staff are welcome to utilize. Regardless of location, this role requires periodic in-person meetings and travel to support NBCDI’s national work and network. The anticipated salary range is $160,000 - $200,000 commensurate with experience. NBCDI offers a comprehensive benefits package including employer-subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision insurance, employer-paid life and AD&D insurance; long-term disability coverage; a 403(b) retirement plan with employer match; generous PTO, sick and parental leave; and tuition reimbursement and professional development support.
